_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Uwanek d uwanek vs Dealer

📖 AḍRIS N UDLIS:
• Tazmilt n yichipiyen n tazwara: {start_chips}
• Uẓawan n yikarḍiyen: 52 yikarḍiyen (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Uwanek d uwanek vs Dealer (axxam)
• Kraygat tawla tazeggaɣt tettwassen s yifasen n Ultimate Texas Hold'em: uwanek yesseɣra ANTE d BLIND, yesseɣra 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek, yesseɣra PLAY n yikarḍiyen n uwanek, yeqqel 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek, yeqqel yikarḍiyen n uwanek d yikarḍiyen n Dealer. Lmeɛna n uwanek d aḥraz n yichipiyen n uwanek (mi uwanek yesseɣra yikarḍi d-ameẓẓan), mi uwanek yesseɣra yikarḍi d-ameqqran.
• Uwanek yeqqel mi uwanek yesseɣra 0 yichipiyen neɣ d-uleɣɣal n tazwara n tawla (TAYA) neɣ kammel 1000 tawliwin d yichipiyen (RAY)

💰 TAZMILT N YIKARḌIYEN:
• ANTE: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n ante ${ante} kraygat tawla
• BLIND: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n blind ${ante} kraygat tawla
• PLAY: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n play. Deg tawla, uwanek yezmer ad yili kan waḥed n yigawen n tɣawsa: (${ante4} mi d-yella deg PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} mi d-yella deg FLOP, neɣ ${ante} mi d-yella deg RIVER. Yezmer daɣen ad yeqqel deg river, ad yeqqel yikarḍi n uwanek, d ad yeqqel tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n uwanek.)

🎴 TAZMILT N YIKARḌIYEN:
• Uwanek yesseɣra 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek
• Dealer yesseɣra 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek
• 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek ttwaqqeln deg tazwara
• Yikarḍiyen n uwanek ttwaqqeln s yifasen n uwanek

🏆 TAZMILT N DEALER:
• Dealer yesseɣra kan PAIR (2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi) ad yili, s yikarḍiyen n uwanek d 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek.
• Tazmilt n Dealer tettwassen s yifasen n uwanek, am ttwaqqel deg uḍris n uwanek.

🎮 YIFASEN N UDLIS & TAZMILT N YIGAWEN:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Tazmilt n yigawen: [4x] (${ante4}) neɣ [check]
  • [4x]: Tazmilt n ${ante4} PLAY, ttwaqqel 3 yikarḍiyen n uwanek
  • [check]: Ulac n tazmilt n yikarḍiyen, ttwaqqel 3 yikarḍiyen n uwanek

📋 FLOP:
  • Mi 4x bet yettwasen: Kan [skip] i yezmer ad yili (auto-reveals last 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek)
  • Mi ulac 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) neɣ [check]
  • [2x]: Tazmilt n ${ante2} PLAY, ttwaqqel 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek
  • [check]: Ulac n tazmilt n yikarḍiyen, ttwaqqel 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek

📋 RIVER:
  • Mi 4x neɣ 2x bet yettwasen: Kan [skip] i yezmer ad yili (auto-proceeds to showdown)
  • Mi ulac PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) neɣ [fold]
  • [1x]: Tazmilt n ${ante} PLAY, yeqqel s showdown
  • [fold]: Yeqqel yikarḍi n uwanek, yeqqel tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n uwanek

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Yikarḍiyen n uwanek ttwaqqeln d yezmer ad yili
  • Yikarḍi n uwanek yezmer ad yili s 7 yikarḍiyen (2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek + 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek)
  • Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwassen s yifasen n uwanek

💎 TAZMILT N YIKARḌIYEN:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ur yezmir ara ad yili: PUSH (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel)
  • Dealer yezmir ad yili & uwanek yezmir ad yili: 1:1 payout (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen + yichipiyen)
  • Dealer yezmir ad yili & uwanek ur yezmir ara ad yili: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel
  • Tie: PUSH (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ur yezmir ara ad yili s tazmilt n Dealer
  • Uwanek yezmir ad yili: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel d tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n uwanek
  • Uwanek ur yezmir ara ad yili: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel
  • Tie: PUSH (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ulac n tazmilt n yikarḍiyen

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ur yezmir ara ad yili s tazmilt n Dealer
  • Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen n uwanek d yikarḍi n Dealer
  • Uwanek yezmir ad yili: 1:1 payout (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen + yichipiyen)
  • Uwanek ur yezmir ara ad yili: Tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel
  • Tie: PUSH (tazmilt n yikarḍiyen tettwabeddel)

🎯 TAZMILT N YIKARḌIYEN N UDLIS (Ameẓẓan s Umeqqran):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 n yikarḍi n uwanek
  2. Straight Flush: 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  4. Full House: 3 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi + 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  5. Flush: 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  6. Straight: 5 yikarḍiyen n uwanek
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  8. Two Pair: 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi + 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  9. One Pair: 2 yikarḍiyen n uwanek n yikarḍi
  10. High Card: Yikarḍi n uwanek yezmer ad yili

⌨️  TAZMILT N YIGAWEN:
• [4x] neɣ [play bet 4x]: Tazmilt n ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] neɣ [play bet 2x]: Tazmilt n ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] neɣ [play bet 1x]: Tazmilt n ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] neɣ [c]: Check (ulac n tazmilt n yikarḍiyen)
• [fold] neɣ [f]: Fold (yeqqel yikarḍi n uwanek)
• [skip] neɣ [s]: Skip s yifasen n uwanek (mi ulac n tazmilt n yikarḍiyen)

💡 TAZMILT N YIGAWEN:
• Yikarḍiyen n tazwara n uwanek (yikarḍiyen n uwanek, yikarḍiyen n uwanek) yezmer ad yili 4x bets
• Yezmer ad yili tazmilt n Dealer - yikarḍiyen n uwanek yezmer ad yili push mi Dealer ur yezmir ara ad yili
• BLIND bet yezmer ad yili d-ameẓẓan s yikarḍiyen n uwanek (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Yezmer ad yili tazmilt n yichipiyen n uwanek! Mi tazmilt n yichipiyen n uwanek tettwabeddel s 0 neɣ d-uleɣɣal n tazwara n tawla, uwanek yezmer ad yili.

⚠️  TAZMILT N YIGAWEN:
• ANTE d BLIND bets yezmer ad yili kraygat tawla
• PLAY bets yezmer ad yili d-ameẓẓan d yigawen n tɣawsa
• Yezmer ad yili tazmilt n yigawen, d kan waḥed n yigawen n tɣawsa i yezmer ad yili.
